about.title:
Two people,

one end-to-end studio.
about.body: We’re a two-person studio that takes your brand, website and app from first idea to launch, plus the marketing to back it. Small on purpose: you work directly with the people doing the work, start to finish.

one.bio: [I design and build the side people see and touch: interfaces, motion and the way a brand feels on screen.]

two.bio: [I build the side that keeps it all running: APIs, data, integrations and the servers underneath.]

services.title: Everything a brand needs to <glow>show up well.</glow>
services.note: Take one piece or the whole stack. It’s the same two people either way, so nothing gets lost in a handoff.
services.foot: Need all four? That’s the whole point. One team, idea to launch.

branding.title: Branding
branding.desc: Identity systems that stay recognisable everywhere they land, from a favicon to a storefront.

websites.title: Websites
websites.desc: Sites that feel like the brand and move like it too. Designed, built and animated end-to-end.

apps.title: Apps
apps.desc: Products people come back to, thought through from first flow to a fast, polished front-end.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.desc: Once it’s built, we help get it in front of the right people, with a plan instead of guesswork.

process.title: From first call to <glow>live</glow> in four steps.
process.sub: No handoffs, no middle-men. The same two people carry your project the whole way. Here’s how a build usually goes.

discover.title: We get to know the work.
discover.body: A kickoff to understand your business, audience and goals: what success looks like, and what’s gotten in the way so far. No templates, no assumptions.
discover.deliver: You leave with [a clear brief & timeline]

design.title: We shape how it looks and feels.
design.body: Brand direction, then every screen, designed and prototyped so you can click through and feel it long before a line of code is written.

build.title: We make it real, end-to-end.
build.body: We develop the whole thing ourselves: fast, animated and built to last. You stay in the loop with working previews, not status emails.

launch.title: We ship it, then help it grow.
launch.body: We launch, hand over the keys, and stick around with a marketing plan to get it in front of the right people. A plan, not guesswork.

fit.title: Pick a starting point. <glow>We’ll shape the rest together.</glow>
fit.sub: These are the ways we usually work, not a fixed menu. Find the closest fit, hit the button, and we’ll figure out the details over a real conversation.

basic.name: Basic
basic.tag: A single-page or smaller website. Clean, custom and unmistakably ours.
includes: Custom responsive design in our style

pro.name: Pro
pro.tag: A larger, multi-page website in our signature animated style. The full experience.

custom.name: Custom
custom.tag: Apps & bespoke products, for when you need more than a website.

addons.lead: Add anything below to any package.

contact.title: Tell us what you’re <glow>dreaming up.</glow>
contact.lede: A few quick questions, one at a time, no pressure. However half-formed the idea, we’d love to hear it.
contact.founders: The two of us read every message and usually reply within a day.

name.hint: No formalities needed, just the name your friends use.
name.error: Any name works, even a nickname.

project.hint: A brand, a website, an app, a wild idea on a napkin. Tell us in a sentence.
project.placeholder: e.g. a storefront for our coffee roastery
project.error: A sentence is plenty. Just give us the gist.

timeline.hint: Rough is fine. Pick what’s closest, or tell us in your own words.
timeline.error: Pick one of the options, or write a few words.

email.hint: We’ll only ever use this to reply. Promise.
email.error: That email doesn’t look quite right.

done.ask: Thanks! Your message is on its way.
done.hint: We’ve got it. Expect a warm, human reply within a day.

contact.failed: Something went wrong sending that. Try again in a moment, or email us directly.
